text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Sev 2: Ravencrest (tenant: ravencrest-pay) | dedicated pool dpool-7 high tail latency + increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate. Traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/abc123. Paging @devon oncall.

devon: Ack. I'm on call. Pulling logs and pool metrics.

sylvie: Looking at dpool-7 — GPU util spiking on node g-12, KV cache miss rate jumped ~x4, p99 latency ~220ms. Errors concentrated on long-context requests (>2048 tokens). Suggest emergency safe-variant fallback at tenant level while we triage.

maria-cs: Ravencrest team is active. Primary contact Claire (claire@ravencrest.com). They're seeing payment timeouts; want mitigation now.

ajay: Current live model: model:raven/llama-13b-v2-ptq:b3 on the dedicated pool. We have a verified safe variant: model:raven/llama-7b-safe-v1 (quantized, lower KV pressure). Can route tenant traffic to that variant temporarily.

devon: Proposed plan (short): 1) Canary 5% traffic -> safe variant for 10m 2) If healthy, pin tenant to safe variant and scale pool up 3) Flush prefix/KV cache for tenant 4) Postmortem/RCA. Who can enact canary + pin?

sylvie: I'll push the canary via control-plane API. Command I will run: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/tenants/ravencrest/route \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \\  -d '{"traffic_split":{"model:raven/llama-7b-safe-v1":0.05,"model:raven/llama-13b-v2-ptq:b3":0.95},"note":"Emergency canary 5% safevariant for latency"}'
```

opsbot: Action scheduled by sylvie at 2024-11-09T02:15:30Z. Canary pushed.

devon: Observing metrics for canary window. Canary p99 ~110ms, errors for canary traffic dropped to 0.8% vs 6% baseline. Safevariant looks stable. Recommend pin + cache clear + autoscale.

ajay: Pin endpoint (for reference): 

PATCH /api/tenants/ravencrest/pin
Body: {"pinned_model":"model:raven/llama-7b-safe-v1","reason":"Emergency fallback during latency spike"}

devon: sylvie, please apply pin and clear caches. Quick snippets: 

```bash
curl -X PATCH https://console.redwood.ai/api/tenants/ravencrest/pin \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \\  -d '{"pinned_model":"model:raven/llama-7b-safe-v1","reason":"latency spike 2024-11-09"}'

curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/tenants/ravencrest/cache/clear \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \\  -d '{}'
```

sylvie: Pin applied at 2024-11-09T02:23:41Z. Cache cleared for tenant ravencrest-pay. Autoscaler triggered +2 GPUs to dpool-7 (requested). Notified Ravencrest contact.

maria-cs: Claire confirmed fallback stopped the timeouts. They're OK staying on safe variant while you investigate. Asking for ETA to resume 13b.

ajay: We'll evaluate PTQ artifact and kernel dispatch path; early guess is a quantization kernel regression increasing KV cache pressure under long sequences. Estimate 6-12 hours for a patch and safe rollback path. Will prioritize.

devon: I'll update the incident page and hand off to daytime oncall (rotation) for monitoring and RCA follow-up. Create customer incident note in support ticket INC-2024-1123-03.

opsbot: Incident log created: INC-2024-1123-03. Notifying next-oncall rotation.

maria-cs: I'll send a customer update: "We've temporarily routed traffic to a verified safe model to stabilize latency while engineers investigate. We'll provide an update within 1 hour." :white_check_mark:

devon: Thanks. Monitoring. If error rate increases or user-facing impact returns, escalate to SEV1 and pull ML infra.

sylvie: Leaving this thread with pinned variant in place and autoscale in effect. Will append metrics and timeline to the incident doc.

devon: Handing off to daytime oncall. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
